summary: PRI-1115 final bounded fix: a trusted hookInvocationId no longer establishes an experiment-level strong link on its own. After the hook id matches, already-declared run/session identities are still checked; a declared mismatch, or several mutually conflicting declarations in one record, yields contradictory_identity with experimentLevelStrongLink=false. Missing identities stay unknown and no new required fields were added. Two real-CLI regression tests failed on the old implementation and pass after the minimal fix. Weak candidates, ambiguity reporting, semantic-conflict deduplication and the dynamic brief are unchanged. PR #2396 is rebased onto latest main, CI is green, and it is not merged.
